model: JOY BACnet room thermostats / fan coil controllers (5DO, ECAO2DO, HCAO2DO, EC3AO, HC3AO)
applies_to: Thermokon JOY wall thermostats with RS485 BACnet MS/TP for fan coils, heating/cooling valves and 6-way valves, in 230 V and 24 V versions with optional CO2 and humidity sensors.
summary: JOY is a touch-display room thermostat that runs its own heating/cooling control for fan coils, valves and 6-way valves, with a time program, ECO mode and up to two universal inputs. Its BACnet MS/TP interface exposes the measured values and states, plus 'overwrite' objects the BMS uses to set occupancy, ECO, setpoint, change-over, fan stage and the outputs. Configuration is done with Thermokon's uConfig tool and sent as a file over BACnet.
default_device_instance: Offset Device ID (AV 100, default 100) + MAC address
notes: Object list from section 9.1 of the JOY BACnet description, revision 5 (23.06.2025), pages 45-49, plus the file object from section 7.3.

Several objects exist only on some variants (column 'Type' in the manual): AI 8-9 on EC 3AO/HC 3AO, AI 10 on HC 3AO/HC AO2DO, AI 11 on EC 3AO/EC AO2DO, BI 8-9 on relay variants, keys BI 12-13 on HC variants.

The fan-stage states differ by variant. Shown here are the 5DO states; on EC 3AO/EC AO2DO, MI 2 runs 1=off, 2-6=stages, 7=Auto Off, 8-12=Auto stages and MV 2 runs 1=off, 2-6=stage 1-5, 7=AUTO; HC variants use 1=off, 2-4=stage 1-3 on MV 2.
The manual has no access column; inputs are shown read-only and values writable.

integration.summary: Set the MAC address and baud rate in the JOY parameter menu, then command the unit through the overwrite objects: Device state (BV 1), occupancy (BV 2), ECO (BV 5), base setpoint (AV 1) and fan stage (MV 2). Read the room temperature, active setpoints, controller state and alarm inputs.

minimum_points.name: Set point base overwrite
minimum_points.why: Base setpoint; -1 returns to local setting

integration.enable: Device state overwrite (BV 1) switches the unit between on and standby; Occupancy state overwrite (BV 2) and ECO mode overwrite (BV 5) set the operating mode. An occupied command can override an active ECO mode if that option is configured.
integration.remote_sensors: Dew point (BV 3) and window (BV 4) states can come from the BMS instead of wired inputs. Writing the base setpoint (AV 1) overrides the time program until -1 is written back; output overwrites (AV 8-11) also use -1 for automatic.
setup: MAC address 0-127 and baud rate are set in the parameter menu.
Device instance = Offset Device ID (AV 100, default 100) + MAC address.
Configuration (time program, inputs, controller) is written as confJoy.bin through BACnet file transfer (FILE 0) with uConfig.
gotchas: A written base setpoint stays in force and disables the time channel until -1 is written.
Output overwrite AVs keep forcing the output until set back to -1.
